material.locator: AHA, “Introduction to Doing World History”: opening discussion of cross-cultural study and comparisons between societies; paragraph beginning “Most fundamentally…” on cross-cultural events/phenomena, historical development and comparison of patterns where interaction is limited.
material.description: The AHA resource supports cross-cultural comparison and contextualized comparison of differing historical patterns. The Claim's non-universal-trajectory clause is retained as a methodological scope constraint, not presented as a separate empirical law established by the page.
